spec_match.rationale: Probes the three distinct surfaces the spec gives the new space — <color> value, gradient interpolation space, color-mix() space — each with its own exact CSS.supports probe.

interactive.rationale: Four endpoint-pair buttons re-render four gradient bars and four color-mix chips with computed serializations; rejected spaces render hatched with an explicit label.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises interpolation probes plus live comparison; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Per-space rejection handled independently, so a browser that takes the colour but not the interpolation space (or vice versa) is reported accurately; the readout names exactly which spaces were rejected.

references.rationale: ChromeStatus and CSS Color 4 interpolation links present.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite pins the colour-value contracts; interpolation-space acceptance is intentionally probed live rather than asserted, since the spec's interpolation grammar for the linear spaces is the open question the page surfaces.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 (pre-144 engine) via CDP/puppeteer: every control driven at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch; full-page screenshots read; console clean except a sandbox-blocked external Google Fonts fetch (net::ERR_CONNECTION_RESET, environment egress proxy, not the demo); zero same-origin failures; zero horizontal overflow. All four endpoint pairs clicked; srgb/display-p3/oklab bars rendered, display-p3-linear bar honestly hatched on 141; mix chips serialize (e.g. oklab(0.5 ...)).

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts probes-ran, linear-space-renders when the gradient probe passes, and the fallback branch otherwise.

design_system.rationale: Variables for UI chrome; gradient/mix literals are the feature under test.

accessibility.rationale: Button group with aria-label, aria-live readout, 44px buttons, dashed midpoint ticks are decorative with the comparison described in text. Toggle state is exposed via aria-pressed after review.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Zero overflow both classes; bars and mix grid reflow to one column at 360px.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify the supported path on Chrome 144+
openQuestions.detail: Verification ran on Chromium 141, which predates the feature, so only the unsupported/fallback branch could be exercised in-browser (it behaved correctly and honestly). When a 144+ Chrome/Canary is available, re-run the page: the support badge must flip, chips/bars must render in display-p3-linear, and the RCS cross-checks must report agreement within tolerance.

openQuestions.title: Record whether Chrome 144 accepts display-p3-linear as an interpolation space
openQuestions.detail: CSS.supports('background-image','linear-gradient(in display-p3-linear, red, lime)') and the color-mix equivalent are probed live because the interpolation grammar for the linear predefined spaces is newer than the colour-value grammar. Once a 144+ browser is available, record the actual answers on the page's conformance story (as a NEW assertion if warranted — never edit the existing suite).

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive demo layout without horizontal overflow mobile touch targets
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Design tokens/variables, >=44px touch targets, visible focus, :not()-style intent selectors, gradients/color-mix guidance.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All chrome UI colours use public/styles.css variables; range inputs and buttons have min-height 44px; native controls keep default focus rings; wide content scrolls in its own overflow-x container.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP probes: overflow 0 / clipped 0 at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 (screenshots are generated locally by deno task responsive-check; reports/responsive/**/*.png is gitignored by design)

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use intrinsic sizing (minmax(min(Npx,100%),1fr)) grids instead of fixed columns so panels reflow on narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Swatch pairs, converter panel, mix grid and supports cards all use repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(...,100%),1fr)); dl uses max-content/minmax(0,1fr) after a squeezed-column bug was caught on the desktop screenshot and fixed.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: puppeteer probe: documentElement.scrollWidth - clientWidth == 0 at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800 on all four concepts

guidanceConsulted.query: interactive color space demo slider controls accessible live readout
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Label every control, expose state changes through text/live regions, keep keyboard operability with native elements.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied on this page: endpoint pair buttons exposed as toggles with aria-pressed kept in sync with the active class, aria-labelled probe/button groups, aria-live gradient readout naming per-surface rejections.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP interaction transcript recorded in this critique's runtime_evidence rationale and the PR commit messages (2026-08-30)

summary: Practical/composition angle. On Chromium 141 all three probes honestly read 'no', the display-p3-linear bar and mix chip render as labelled rejections, and the srgb/display-p3/oklab comparisons work for every endpoint pair. A detached-element getComputedStyle bug that blanked the mix serializations was caught in CDP driving and fixed before commit. [review follow-up 2026-08-30] Codex: endpoint pair buttons now expose aria-pressed state, toggled with the active class (verified via CDP). [review follow-up 2026-08-30 #2] Codex contrast findings fixed: supported badges now --text-black on emerald (5.10:1), success/match readouts use black-on-emerald chips or charcoal text (12+:1), padding warning charcoal (12.4:1), webcrypto status-ok charcoal (13.1:1); all measured live via computed styles. [review follow-up 2026-08-30 #3] Codex: gradient and color-mix rejections are now tracked and reported separately (verified live: the readout names both), with an added p3lin-mix-linear-space-renders telemetry assert, so partial implementations are reported honestly.
